name: Balaji Telefilms Limited
summary: Balaji Telefilms Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the television content business in India and internationally. The company operates through the Commissioned Programmes, Films, and Digital segments. It is also involved in the production of films, reality shows, and events; event business; B2C and B2B digital content business; distribution of films; operation of a subscription-based video on demand (SVOD) over the top (OTT) platform; and ethnic wear and jewelry business. In addition, the company operates Hoonur, a platform for media professionals and entertainment consumers. It operates its business under the Balaji Telefilms, Balaji Motion, ALTT, Alt Entertainment, Chhayabani Balaji, Marinating Films, and Brand EK brands. Balaji Telefilms Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Mumbai, India.
